positive_snippets: The rooms were decent and clean. Service was prompt. Don't know much about the tariff but it's not that expensive. They do have a pool as well. It is surrounded by a village though so dont expect good views from your balcony if you have one.
negative_snippets:
I stayed here recently and the experience was far below what a 4-star property should offer. The hotel feels more like a 2-star. The room was not clean, the bathroom and toilet were dirty, and even basic things like the remote and telephone were unclean. I even saw a cockroach near the lift. Except for the bedding, everything else in the room needed proper cleaning.

At check-in, the reception staff didn’t greet or acknowledge us—no welcome, no assistance. Overall staff behavior was not friendly or attentive. Even basic essentials like towels were not kept in the room and had to be requested.

Housekeeping staff was polite and helpful whenever asked, but ideally the room should have been clean from the start.

Another major concern was the atmosphere in the hotel. Staff members on the ground floor were loudly talking, running around the corridor and pool/restaurant area, and even carrying beer bottles. There was no proper uniform or professional behaviour, which made the place feel quite cheap and unmanaged.

Overall, definitely not a 4-star experience. Needs serious improvement in cleanliness, staff training, and professionalism.

Hi,

I am writing to provide feedback regarding a recent experience with your staff, which I found to be highly unsatisfactory, especially considering the reputation of your brand.

A family member inadvertently left her ID card at your hotel. Despite numerous attempts, both my family and a courier service faced significant difficulty in arranging its collection. My calls, as well as those from the courier, were often unanswered. When a staff member finally did answer, their attitude and words were, frankly, humiliating and arrogant.

This level of nonchalant behavior and lack of assistance for such an important document is deeply concerning. It has led me to decide that my company will no longer make corporate bookings at your hotel. I believe your team should proactively ensure important documents are returned to guests, rather than making the process so challenging.

As a result of this experience, I incurred additional charges not only for the attempted pickup but also for rescheduling it multiple times due to the lack of cooperation. I am extremely disappointed and shocked by the poor service.

Regards,
An irritated Guest.
